The '''D'Asta family''' was the most influential family of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="TEA" />

Its [[D'Asta private fleet|fleet]] was the largest private [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the D'Asta [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] from [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] made their fortune establishing various markets along the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] in the New Territories.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The D'Asta family was introduced in ''Crimson Empire''; to give them a role commensurate with their apparent status in that series, we made them into galactic power brokers and cemented this by identifying them with Serenno, Count Dooku's homeworld.|[[Jason Fry]]|<ref name="Geekosity">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 1 of 5)}}</ref>}}
The D'Asta family were created for the comic miniseries [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'']], by [[Mike Richardson]] and [[Randy Stradley]]. In ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], the D'Asta family was established as power brokers in the galaxy to commensurate their apparent status in ''Crimson Empire''.<ref name="Geekosity" />
